name: stoop
description: Unofficial NYC apartment search for AI agents: a Cloudflare Worker exposing an MCP server for rental search by neighborhood, subway stop or any place, plus public building records.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Your sign-in for `/admin`, where you mint API keys and read the audit log, and for approving OAuth clients. Use a long random passphrase.

COOKIE_SIGNING_KEY.description: Signs the admin session cookie. 32 random bytes as hex: run `openssl rand -hex 32`.

ZYTE_API_KEY.description: StreetEasy blocks datacenter IPs, so searches go through [Zyte](https://www.zyte.com/). Paste your Zyte API key. Other providers are in the README.
